Entire silhouette, hair, cape or coat tails, both hands where visible and both boot soles inside frame; 92–96 percent visible height with 2–4 percent top/bottom padding. One isolated character on genuine transparent alpha. No scenery, props, weapons, floor, cast shadow, UI, labels, watermark, floating symbols or effects.
